notes.title: THE WORLD MAILBOX UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello all ːdentonː



It's been a little while hasn't it ? I’ve been working on life and other projects, but this game still has my heart, so alongside everything else, I’ve been adding in new things, making this update.


New Journal System
Players can now create as many journal pages as they please.

Each page can either use a pre-defined prompt (written by Naveen ofc), or choose to title them yourself.

Each page also lets you pick a mood to reflect how you’re feeling that day.


Design Updates
Sol got a whole new look! the old one was a bit too thin and didn’t scale well. The new look is softer, warmer, and fits her mother-like persona alot better.

Neptune now has cool waterfall-like visual effects flowing through its body.

Jupiter now has her tail! idk why she never had one to begin with.


New Character Animations
Gave all the characters some bone-based animations. Everyone feels more alive and expressive now.


Inventory/Bag
The inventory is now _always visible_ on the HUD.

Added a juicy pop-in/out effect when you open/close the bag. Super satisfying.


Colour Customisation System
Added a system allowing you to change the colours of your collected items.

This system also works with the letters in the mailbox system (more on that later).


Redesigned the Report Card
New look + new approach to stat tracking. 


Polished some minigames
Aphrodite’s Habit Minigame

New sound effects, animations, and icons.

Habits now have unique icons, helping to visually sort what’s “good” or “bad” in a more interactive way.



Neptune’s Self-Love Minigame

Tried giving it more visual feedback;

Input box flashes correct/incorrect colours.

Added a progress indicator - Neptune starts out as a chaotic splash, but slowly takes shape as you make positive progress with your thoughts (symbolism).



Atlas’ Meditation Minigame

Also tried giving it more visual feedback;

Now there’s a calming Atlas illustration, filling up as you meditate.

Also added an illustrated breathing guide, showing you how to inhale through the nose, and exhale through the mouth. It's pretty cute.


Spotlight System
Whenever you interact with something (a character, your inventory, the mailbox), the background now darkens to keep focus on what matters.


Settings Menu
Reworked the look and layout of settings, tidying everything up.


Information Screen
Slightly improved the look of it too, with a cleaner layout and animated text.


Sol's Mood System
Before venting, Sol now gently asks how you’re feeling.

You’ll see a bunch of illustrated emotions to choose from, a low-pressure way to express/identify your current emotional status.



now, last but not least...
THE NEW WORLD MAILBOX SYSTEM !!!
my favourite things I’ve added.

a system to ask questions to the strangers of our world, and to read their thoughts.



Envelopes = Questions, Letters = Answers.

You (the player) can send letters (that you write) to envelopes (that I write). It’s a lil wholesome community-driven system for sharing and connecting with one another.

I've made the letters customisable using different shapes, colours, and Unity's TextMeshPro tool. Boldness, text colour, size, alignment, opacity etc, make your message truly unique, like you.

Envelopes come with their own unique themes; such as heart-shaped letters for love-related topics, or “note” style letters for "messages to strangers".





Thank you all for your continued support with my game development journey, i hope you all enjoy what this update has to offer :).



See you soon in future updates and or in the next project,

Malachi

notes.title: the OVERHAUL update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=P6_ZDmHncfg;full][/previewyoutube]

ART & DESIGN OVERHAUL

 redesigned the pause menu
 redesigned aphrodite
 added variety to origami paper
 added variety to journal covers
 added variety to the "Note To Strangers" notes


ANIMATION OVERHAUL

 camera now slightly zooms in to/out of player when pausing
 camera pans around based on what the player is looking at
 camera now blurs when using the journal, or doing tasks/mini-games
 camera now zooms to focus on whoever is speaking
 pause menu fades in and out
 pause menu containers slightly sway
 inventory now slides in and out of view
 items within the inventory now slide in and out of view
 origami now slightly bounces when folding


DIALOGUE SYSTEM OVERHAUL

 added a speaking style, colour, and sound to every character (including the player),
each setup is made to match the character and personality
 cleaned up some of the actual dialogue (grammar, readability, player responses etc)


MUSIC OVERHAUL

 added a playlist system, music randomly cycles through 3 songs. despite there only being 3 songs, the system will never play the same song twice in a row
 (WIP, NOT YET AVAILABLE) added character themes, when speaking to a character, the current track will transition to that characters theme


OTHER

 added more journal prompts
 added more note messages
 improved note spawn system & altered all spawn locations
 fixed some bugs (OOB save corruption, neptune minigame completion acknowledgenent, jupiter minigame restart, aphrodite minigame restart)


if you run into any new (or old) bugs, PLEASE let me know, the best place to contact me is in our discord server. hope you all enjoy the update :)
